missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Текст' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Сложный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the difficulty.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Текст' is the accusative direct object of 'перевёл'. As an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative, with 'весь' agreeing.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Текста' takes the genitive after 'нет', stating the text is missing. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Тексту' is in the dative after 'к', showing a return toward the text. 'Статьи' is a genitive naming the article.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Текстом' is in the instrumental after 'над', marking the text as the object of work. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Тексте' takes the prepositional form after 'в' to show where the errors are. 'Несколько ошибок' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Тексты' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' and 'длинные' agree in the plural, with 'слишком' intensifying.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Текста' takes the genitive after 'смысл', expressing the meaning of the text. 'Непонятным' is the instrumental predicate after 'остался'.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Тексты' is the accusative plural object of 'проверил', matching the nominative plural form. 'Все' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Текст' takes the accusative after 'в' to show insertion into the text. The form matches the nominative for this inanimate noun.
